answer: Concrete sybil resistance via lantern hunting: a rotating pool of 12 lantern auditors patrols each epoch, paid 800 POA for proving a duplicate identity and fined 2,400 POA for a false claim. Every new agent enters through a narrow signal: a 15,000 POA bond time-locked 18 epochs plus a 21-day cooling period before first payout. A bridge of lineage records each invitation chain, and any cluster sharing an ancestor beyond depth 2 is frozen. An attacker running N sybils must post 15,000N POA for 18 epochs and hide lineage from 12 auditors, so expected cost exceeds any gain.
